summary: Confirmed $50/night (weekly $300) and water + 50-amp at the 38 weekend/nightly sites, which book online on ActivityReg; added no pull-throughs, showers/dump, season Apr 15-Oct 31, weekend 2-night and holiday 3-night minimums. Note trimmed of site counts, season and rating now in fields.
